tools.name: sap_pm_get_equipment
tools.description: Retrieve SAP PM equipment master data (IE03) by equipment ID or functional location, including manufacturer, model, serial number, object type, and warranty dates.

tools.name: sap_pm_get_maintenance_plan
tools.description: Retrieve a SAP PM maintenance plan (IP10) for an equipment ID, including cycle, task list, and next due date, used to compute interval utilization.

tools.name: sap_pm_get_breakdown_history
tools.description: Retrieve read-only breakdown history (PM Info System) for an equipment ID, including MTBF, MTTR, downtime hours, and cost, used to avoid scheduling routine PM immediately adjacent to a recent breakdown window.

tools.name: sap_pm_create_notification
tools.description: Create a SAP PM maintenance notification (IW21) for a breakdown or observed issue on a piece of equipment.

tools.name: sap_pm_create_planned_order
tools.description: Create a SAP PM maintenance order (IW31, order type PM01) for a scheduled preventive maintenance task. The order is created in 'Planned, Unreleased' status only — it must never be released to the shop floor by this tool. Requires human approval: a Maintenance Planner must release the order in SAP PM, or approve the release via the Teams adaptive-card workflow, before it becomes an active shop-floor work order.

tools.name: sap_pm_post_completion_confirmation
tools.description: Post a completion confirmation (actual date, actual hours, technician, findings) back to an existing SAP PM maintenance order once the PM task has been performed.
